questions.question_bn: If $f(x) = \frac{2x + 1}{x - 3}$ ( $x \ne 3$ ), what is the inverse function $f^{-1}(x)$ ?
questions.explanation: $y = \frac{2x+1}{x-3} \Rightarrow xy - 3y = 2x + 1 \Rightarrow x(y-2) = 3y+1 \Rightarrow x = \frac{3y+1}{y-2}$. So $f^{-1}(x) = \frac{3x+1}{x-2}$.

questions.question_bn: What is the value of $\int_0^1 \frac{x}{1 + x^4} dx$ ?
questions.explanation: Let $z = x^2 \Rightarrow dz = 2x dx$. Sum $= \frac{1}{2}\int_0^1 \frac{dz}{1+z^2} = \frac{1}{2}[\tan^{-1}z]_0^1 = \frac{1}{2}(\frac{\pi}{4}) = \frac{\pi}{8}$.

questions.question_bn: What is the inverse matrix of $\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 3 & 4 \end{bmatrix}$ matrix?

questions.question_bn: If $f(x) = \frac{2x + 1}{x - 3}$ ( $x \ne 3$ ), what is the inverse function $f^{-1}(x)$ ?
questions.explanation: $y = \frac{2x+1}{x-3} \Rightarrow xy - 3y = 2x + 1 \Rightarrow x(y-2) = 3y+1 \Rightarrow x = \frac{3y+1}{y-2}$. So $f^{-1}(x) = \frac{3x+1}{x-2}$.

questions.question_bn: What is the inverse matrix of $\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 \\ 3 & 4 \end{bmatrix}$ matrix?

questions.explanation: $\vec{A}\cdot\vec{B} = 12 - 6 - 2 = 4$. $|\vec{A}| = \sqrt{4+4+1}=3$ and $|\vec{B}| = \sqrt{36+9+4}=7$. Therefore $\cos\theta = 4/(3 \times 7) = 4/21$.

questions.explanation: $y = \frac{2x+1}{x-3} \Rightarrow xy - 3y = 2x + 1 \Rightarrow x(y-2) = 3y+1 \Rightarrow x = \frac{3y+1}{y-2}$. So $f^{-1}(x) = \frac{3x+1}{x-2}$.
questions.book_reference: SU Ahmed and MA Jabbar (1st Paper)

questions.question_bn: What is the value of $\int_0^1 \frac{x}{1 + x^4} dx$ ?
questions.explanation: Let $z = x^2 \Rightarrow dz = 2x dx$. Sum $= \frac{1}{2}\int_0^1 \frac{dz}{1+z^2} = \frac{1}{2}[\tan^{-1}z]_0^1 = \frac{1}{2}(\frac{\pi}{4}) = \frac{\pi}{8}$.

questions.question_bn: If two vectors $\vec{A} = 2\hat{i} - 3\hat{j} + 2\hat{k}$ and $\vec{B} = m\hat{i} + 4\hat{j} + m\hat{k}$ are perpendicular to each other, what is the value of $m$?
questions.explanation: The condition that two vectors are perpendicular $\vec{A} \cdot \vec{B} = 0$. $2m - 12 + 2m = 0 \Rightarrow 4m = 12 \Rightarrow m = 3$.

questions.subject: HigherMath
questions.question_bn: What is the equation of the straight line through the point $(1, 2)$ and parallel to the line $3x - 4y + 7 = 0$?
questions.explanation: The equation of the parallel line is 3x - 4y + k = 0$. For the point $(1,2)$ : $3(1) - 4(2) + k = 0 \Rightarrow k = 5$ . So the line is 3x - 4y + 5 = 0.

questions.book_reference_en: SU Ahmed and MA Jabbar (1st Paper)

questions.question_bn: If $f(x) = \frac{2x + 1}{x - 3}$ ( $x \ne 3$ ), what is the inverse function $f^{-1}(x)$ ?
questions.explanation: $y = \frac{2x+1}{x-3} \Rightarrow xy - 3y = 2x + 1 \Rightarrow x(y-2) = 3y+1 \Rightarrow x = \frac{3y+1}{y-2}$. So $f^{-1}(x) = \frac{3x+1}{x-2}$.

questions.question_bn: What is the value of $\int_0^1 \frac{x}{1 + x^4} dx$ ?
questions.explanation: Let $z = x^2 \Rightarrow dz = 2x dx$. Sum $= \frac{1}{2}\int_0^1 \frac{dz}{1+z^2} = \frac{1}{2}[\tan^{-1}z]_0^1 = \frac{1}{2}(\frac{\pi}{4}) = \frac{\pi}{8}$.

questions.explanation: $y = \frac{2x+1}{x-3} \Rightarrow xy - 3y = 2x + 1 \Rightarrow x(y-2) = 3y+1 \Rightarrow x = \frac{3y+1}{y-2}$. So $f^{-1}(x) = \frac{3x+1}{x-2}$.

questions.question_bn: If $f(x) = \frac{2x + 1}{x - 3}$ ( $x \ne 3$ ), what is the inverse function $f^{-1}(x)$ ?
questions.explanation: $y = \frac{2x+1}{x-3} \Rightarrow xy - 3y = 2x + 1 \Rightarrow x(y-2) = 3y+1 \Rightarrow x = \frac{3y+1}{y-2}$. So $f^{-1}(x) = \frac{3x+1}{x-2}$.

questions.question_bn: What is the value of $\int_0^1 \frac{x}{1 + x^4} dx$ ?

questions.question_bn: What is the value of the $x$-excluded term in the expansion of $\left(x + \frac{1}{x}\right)^{10}$?

questions.book_reference: SU Ahmed and MA Jabbar (2nd Paper)
